messages:
marta: Quick sync — PR #482 (structured responses) landed but reviewers flagged three things: missing JS SDK snippet, unclear nullable-field guidance for schema, and a broken link to the parsing guide. Can we triage?
kevin: I can do the JS snippet, but need the exact output shape you want shown. small example please.
oliver: FYI the Python SDK example also needs to show the new `response.envelope` casing we agreed on. I'll update if we lock the shape.
sasha: Schema note — we should recommend `oneOf` for optional tool outputs rather than `nullable` everywhere. Nullable causes downstream parsers to conflate types. Example I put in-thread: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"result":{"oneOf":[{"type":"null"},{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}}}]}}}```
kevin: Nice, that oneOf example is helpful. For the JS snippet I can do: ```js
const res = await client.generate({model:'x-small', input:'...'});
console.log(res.response.envelope.result?.id ?? 'no-id');
```
marta: Perfect. @oliver please mirror the behaviour in Python: `res.response.envelope.get('result')` style. Also add a short note about the parse fallback pattern: prefer `?.` and explicit null checks instead of trying to coerce types.
oliver: Will do. Also noticed the link to the parsing guide goes to /parse->old which 404s. doc-bot, can you suggest the correct target?
doc-bot: Found candidate: https://docs.redwood.com/inference/structured-responses/parse-patterns. Proposed replacement in PR comment.
sasha: One more content suggestion — add a tiny subsection called "schema-first examples" that shows how to validate before converting to application types. e.g. use `ajv` snippet for JS and `jsonschema` for Python. Keeps users from depending on lax parsing.
kevin: I'll add ajv snippet. Quick draft: ```js
const Ajv = require('ajv');
const ajv = new Ajv();
const valid = ajv.validate(schema, res.response.envelope.result);
if (!valid) throw new Error('response failed schema check');
```
oliver: Python draft: ```py
from jsonschema import validate, ValidationError
try:
  validate(instance=res['response']['envelope']['result'], schema=schema)
except ValidationError as e:
  # fallback or log
  raise
```
marta: Great. Owners: kevin -> JS snippets & link fix, oliver -> Python snippet + envelope rename in examples, sasha -> schema wording and the oneOf example, I'll update the PR description and squash the small commits. Target to merge by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: tagging @doc-bot to run the link-checker after I push.
doc-bot: Link-check queued for PR #482. Will post results here. :white_check_mark:
marta: Thanks team — small edits but big UX. If anything blocks merge ping me in this thread. :rocket:
